name: Magic Matchup
source:
You're a college student, going to his first day at what seems to be… magician school?! Normally, this wouldn't be a problem, except for one thing… you have no idea what the hell you're even doing here, let alone you've forgotten how to use magic.

Well, no problem, you can just remember it over time, right? …except that your teacher, believe or not, is challenging you to a magical battle right here, right now. Damn.

Obviously, anyone sane would reject this. However… she says that if you win, you'll get something special. Now, thinking to yourself, what the heck could be so special that you'd risk getting your ass kicked in a magical battle–

Oh. She wants to make it a strip battle, and if you win… you get to have your way with her?! Wow, this has turned into one of the craziest first days at school, by a long shot!

[From [url=https://hentaiwriter.itch.io/magic-matchup]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名大学生，今天要去一所看起来像是……魔法师学校的地方上第一天课？！通常这不算问题，但你完全不知道自己为什么在这里，更别说已经忘记如何使用魔法。

没关系，慢慢就能想起来，对吧？……然而，你的老师竟然要在此时此地和你进行魔法决斗。糟了。

正常人当然会拒绝，但她说只要赢了，就能得到特别奖励。你暗自思考，究竟是什么奖励，值得冒着被魔法打得屁滚尿流的风险——

哦，她想进行脱衣决斗；只要你赢了，就可以随心所欲地对待她？！天啊，这绝对是最疯狂的入学第一天！
